inventory.description: Original PNG actually opened at native resolution before this authoring pass: one male head-and-shoulders/chest bust, three-quarter facing image LEFT. Broad high/receding forehead, wavy/curly swept-back hair, strong eyebrows and nose, visible image-right ear, thick moustache and long full beard across chest. No spectacles. The bound lesson p0146#3 identifies J. C. Maxwell (1831-1879); pixels alone do not independently identify a name.

Dark civilian lapelled coat and light shirt opening; complete head, beard and shoulder/chest framing against plain white. Monochrome printed hatching is a source rendering style, not an instructional relationship. No inscription, number, equation, apparatus, flag, uniform, hat, medal or additional person. These requirements map semantically to the single maxwell-portrait artwork asset, not invented geometric assertions.
